decision.reason: [ev-0307de1909a6] plainly says the `istioctl manifest diff` and `istioctl manifest profile diff` commands were removed, so the change type "removed" is correct. The subject is the problem: these are subcommands, not flags, and the cli-flag family needs a name with a leading "--". No family covers CLI subcommands, so no correction fits the vocabulary. The proposed subject also names only `manifest diff`, though the note removes two commands. A human must decide how to represent CLI subcommands before this subject can be settled.
